description: This file contains the implementation of an 'admin' marketing controller class for OpenCart, responsible for handling marketing-related actions such as listing, filtering, and managing marketing campaigns within the admin panel.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing marketing campaigns in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, filtering, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that sets up the marketing page, processes filters from the request, and renders the view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays the list of marketing campaigns, applying filters and pagination, and rendering the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares and returns the list of marketing campaigns based on various filters and sorting options.
